output.summary: A genus of evergreen shrubs and small trees native to warm-temperate and subtropical East and Southeast Asia, Rhaphiolepis has glossy, leathery leaves, white or pink flowers and dark purple-to-black fruits. Some varieties have fruit that is edible when cooked for jam, but some ornamental varieties have no culinary value.
output.edibilityNote: Some varieties have fruit edible when cooked and used for jam; some ornamental varieties produce fruit with no culinary value.
